title: Collective Intelligence & Multi-Agent Asymmetric Disagreement
hypothesis: Multi-agent teams assigned distinct experimental strategies will solve at least 15% more held-out problems than an equal-budget repeated-sampling solo agent.
falsification_criteria: Problem-solving advantage is below 15%, or vanishes when compared against equal-budget independent sampling followed by selection.
